sources.imerg: NASA GPM IMERG Final Run V07

transformations.IMERG: mean of source grid cells per UTC day; no unit conversion (mm/day)
transformations.GLDAS: preserved daily spatial mean and source conversion

warnings: IMERG and GLDAS precipitation are separate source variables and must not be summed.
IMERG is 0.1-degree grid; GLDAS is 0.25-degree grid; POWER is a point value.
No missing-value imputation or interpolation was applied.
